confidenceLegend.EXACT_CLIENT_DATA: Direct numeric data decoded from client resources.
confidenceLegend.EXACT_SCENE_DATA: Direct property or point decoded from SC2.
confidenceLegend.EXACT_GRID_TOPOLOGY: Adjacency derived exactly from the declared analysis grid.
confidenceLegend.NUMERIC_TERRAIN_DERIVATION: Relationship derived from decoded numeric terrain.
confidenceLegend.NAME_HEURISTIC: Category inferred from an asset/entity name; position remains exact.
confidenceLegend.GRID_RULE_DERIVED: Area candidate produced by deterministic grid rules.
confidenceLegend.RULE_DERIVED_CANDIDATE: Vehicle affordance or risk candidate; requires later validation.
